items.title: AI infrastructure stocks surge after strong earnings from CoreWeave, Supermicro
items.summary: AI infrastructure stocks jumped, with shares of AI server makers, optical-products companies, and neocloud providers moving higher.

items.title: How Far Can Arista Stock Move Without Anything Going Wrong?
items.summary: The band the options market prices for the next ten months runs from just under the low this stock has set over the past year to a level far above today's price, and the volatility behind it is close to what the stock has actually been doing.

items.title: Lumentum Rockets 15% on Blowout Earnings, Coherent Climbs 9%, Corning Gains 5% on Optics Earnings and CoreWeave, Super Micro Read-Through
items.summary: Lumentum just torched Wall Street expectations and sent shockwaves through the entire AI optics complex, pulling peers like Coherent, Corning, and Ciena sharply higher as analysts scramble to figure out whether the rally has legs or has already outrun reality.

items.title: Arista Networks Stock Is Waiting On Parts, Not Orders
items.summary: Arista keeps raising its revenue outlook as it locks up components, which makes its supply agreements the real driver of the upside case.

items.title: A 14% Yield On ANET Stock, And A Shot At Buying It 40% Lower
items.summary: Get paid a significant income stream now for agreeing to buy this AI networking star at a discount later, an attractive proposition you keep whether the stock soars or stalls.

items.title: Ciena Down 29% in Past 3 Months: Should Investors Buy, Hold or Sell?
items.summary: CIEN's AI-driven optical networking demand is fueling record revenue and a $7.7 billion backlog, but supply constraints and costs pose key risks.

items.title: Should You Hold on to Applied Optoelectronics Stock Post Q2 Earnings?
items.summary: AAOI's record Q2 revenues and surging AI-driven demand fuel growth, but supply constraints, competition and valuation concerns cloud the outlook.

items.title: Should Lumentum Stock Be in Your Portfolio Pre-Q4 Earnings?
items.summary: LITE heads into fiscal Q4 earnings with strong AI optics demand and a 1.6T transceiver ramp, though supply constraints could limit upside.
